title.narrative: Support Pacific SIDS to protect underwater cultural heritage

description.narrative: Support Pacific SIDS with capacity development initiatives to protect underwater cultural heritage. The workplan will focus support to the two countries that have ratified the Convention as well as Fiji and the Solomon Islands as they progress in their ratification process. The workplan will also support selected countries in their efforts to ratify the 1970 and 2001 Conventions, subject to request from MSs. The activity will include the elaboration of a gap and national interest analysis that will inform the development of an online training suite of curated informative material. The tailored policy advice will aim to provide a better understanding of the benefits and implications of the UCH Convention through capacity building and create synergies with other UNESCO Conventions such as the 1970 Convention on the Means of Prohibiting and Preventing the Illicit Import, Export and Transfer of Ownership of Cultural Property.
